column1: # THE STUDIO NODE-CLASS ALLOWLIST. `studio.run_workflow` refuses any workflow
# whose `class_type` is not a row here (node_not_pinned), before anything is
#   package   `comfyui-core` (ships with the pinned ComfyUI, see
#             `name` of a [[node]] entry in custom-nodes.toml. A row whose
#             package is NOT pinned in custom-nodes.toml admits nothing: the
#             class is listed here ahead of its package so the pin (1956-bh6j)
#             lands without a second edit, but it does not run until then.
#   class     the ComfyUI class_type exactly as the API-format JSON spells it
# 1982-kpin: Qwen-Image-Edit, FLUX.2 and Wan VACE workflow classes (core at v0.40.0).
# 1983-svid: the WebM video output node (a Wan workflow saves through it).
# ---- 1956-bh6j: these packages are pinned in custom-nodes.toml (names match). ----
# 1986-snpx: only Apply and Decode. DecodeRGBA (and DecodeSplit, its
# subclass) call JoinImageWithAlpha.join_image_with_alpha, absent at ComfyUI
# v0.40.0 (AttributeError on the kumbia forge); use Decode + core
# JoinImageWithAlpha with the alpha inverted. Joint/Cond/Diff Apply load
# weights that are not pinned (the studio has no egress).
# 2007-acst: ACE-Step 1.5 text-to-music and the core audio savers (comfy_extras/nodes_ace.py, nodes_audio.py at the pinned v0.40.0).
